cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(walloc_standalone VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX CUDA)
find_package(CUDAToolkit 11.8 REQUIRED)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY Shared)
set(WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Pinned native LibTorch 2.6.0+cu118 prefix (include/ and lib/)")
option(WALLOC_SANITIZERS "Address/undefined sanitizer for translated code" OFF)
option(WALLOC_TSAN "Separate thread sanitizer build" OFF)
if(NOT EXISTS "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/include/ATen/ATen.h")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT to the declared native dependency prefix")
endif()
# Link existing C++ kernels directly: no Python discovery/linking or exported graph.
add_library(walloc_tensor INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(walloc_tensor SYSTEM INTERFACE
  "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/include" "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/include/torch/csrc/api/include")
target_compile_definitions(walloc_tensor INTERFACE _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0)
target_link_libraries(walloc_tensor INTERFACE
  "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/lib/libtorch.so" "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/lib/libtorch_cpu.so"
  "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/lib/libc10.so" "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/lib/libtorch_cuda.so"
  "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/lib/libc10_cuda.so")
set(WEBP_BUILD_ANIM_UTILS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_CWEBP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_DWEBP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_GIF2WEBP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_IMG2WEBP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_VWEBP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_WEBPINFO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_WEBPMUX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_EXTRAS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_LIBWEBPMUX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_LIBWEBPDEMUX OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_BUILD_THREADING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WEBP_ENABLE_SIMD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(third_party/libwebp EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
# Clang 14 crashes lowering scalar floating point with WebP's -mno-sse2 on
# x86_64. Preserve the ABI baseline; generated HAVE_CONFIG_H still disables all
# WebP SSE2/AVX kernels. The vendored source is unmodified.
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang" AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "x86_64")
  foreach(dependency webpdsp webputils webpencode webpdecode sharpyuv)
    target_compile_options(${dependency} PRIVATE -msse2)
  endforeach()
endif()
add_library(walloc_cuda STATIC src/canonical/safe_reduce.cu)
target_include_directories(walloc_cuda PRIVATE third_party/aten_safe)
target_link_libraries(walloc_cuda PUBLIC walloc_tensor CUDA::cudart)
set_target_properties(walloc_cuda PROPERTIES CUDA_STANDARD 17 CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 75)
target_compile_options(walloc_cuda PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--objdir-as-tempdir;--extended-lambda;--expt-relaxed-constexpr;--fmad=false;-Xcompiler=-fno-fast-math,-ffp-contract=off>)
add_library(walloc STATIC src/canonical/walloc.cpp)
target_include_directories(walloc PUBLIC include PRIVATE third_party/libwebp/src)
target_link_libraries(walloc PUBLIC walloc_tensor walloc_cuda webp)
target_compile_features(walloc PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_options(walloc PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
if(WALLOC_SANITIZERS AND WALLOC_TSAN)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "ASan and TSan must use separate builds")
endif()
if(WALLOC_SANITIZERS)
  target_compile_options(walloc PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(walloc PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
  foreach(dependency webpdsp webputils webpencode webpdecode sharpyuv)
    target_compile_options(${dependency} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  endforeach()
elseif(WALLOC_TSAN)
  target_compile_options(walloc PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(walloc PUBLIC -fsanitize=thread)
endif()
add_executable(walloc_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(walloc_cli PRIVATE walloc)
add_executable(walloc_preflight tests/preflight.cpp)
target_link_libraries(walloc_preflight PRIVATE walloc)
add_executable(walloc_tensor_cli tools/tensor_cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(walloc_tensor_cli PRIVATE walloc)
set_target_properties(walloc_cli walloc_preflight walloc_tensor_cli PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${WALLOC_TORCH_ROOT}/lib")
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME independent_preflight COMMAND walloc_preflight)
install(TARGETS walloc walloc_cli ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES include/walloc.hpp include/walloc_tensor.hpp DESTINATION include)
